impact_explanation.interpretation: MODERATE impact variants change the protein but do not destroy it. The actual effect ranges from benign (tolerated substitution in a non-critical region) to damaging (substitution at an active site or conserved residue). Computational tools like SIFT and PolyPhen-2 help distinguish tolerated from deleterious changes, but functional studies provide the strongest evidence.
